//: ContextRuntime HookJournal observation layer -- copy the `hooks` block into your Claude Code
//settings: settings.json (~/.claude/settings.json for all projects, or .claude/settings.json in a repo).
//install: pip install -e /path/to/LLM-Token-efficiency, then the `contextruntime` console script is on PATH.
//db: Override the journal location with the CR_HOOK_DB env var or --db; default ~/.claude/contextruntime/hookjournal.db.
//observe-only: cr-hook is fail-open and always exits 0 -- it can never block or fail a tool call.
//synchronous: Intentionally NOT async: an async PreToolUse would hash the file AFTER the edit runs (time-travel).
//events: Event names verified against code.claude.com/docs/en/hooks.md (Aug 2026). One command handles all events;
//dispatch: cr-hook dispatches on the payload's hook_event_name and silently ignores events it doesn't use.
